what: Lycia is a clinical-stage biotech company using its LYTAC platform to develop medicines, including an IgE portfolio and a Graves' disease program.
risks: It is a young company with no approved products and no completed clinical trials, so it is hard to judge its chances of success.
It has lost a lot of money since it began, has no product sales, and may never make a profit.
Delays or trouble enrolling patients in clinical trials could hold up or block the approvals it needs.
